name: Audible
author: jarod
description: Listen to your Audible books from the Omarchy bar: guided setup, a searchable library, chapters, progress, time left, and playback speed up to 3x and beyond.

barWidget.description: Audiobook player: title, time left, speed. Click for chapters and progress.

schema.label: Speed step
schema.description: How much one speed up/down press or scroll notch changes the playback speed.

schema.label: Fastest speed
schema.description: Upper limit for the speed control. Pitch is corrected, so voices stay natural.

schema.label: Volume step
schema.description: How much one volume key press changes this app's volume. Only affects the audiobook player, not your system volume.

schema.label: Download quality
schema.description: high is about 128 kbps. normal is about half the size, so a new book is ready roughly twice as fast, with little difference for speech.

schema.label: Library scroll speed
schema.description: How many grid rows one mouse-wheel notch scrolls in the library. Higher is faster.

schema.label: Library trackpad scroll speed
schema.description: How far the library grid scrolls for a trackpad swipe. Higher is faster; a quick swipe is boosted further.

schema.label: Rewind a little when resuming
schema.description: After a pause, go back a few seconds so you catch what you missed. Longer pauses go back further (up to 30 seconds). Does not apply on the first play of a book.

schema.label: Continue to the next book in a series
schema.description: When a book ends, start the next book in its series after a 5 second heads-up. Only happens if that book is already downloaded, so nothing large downloads by surprise.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Show a short notice when a download finishes, a book ends, the sleep timer pauses playback, or the next book is about to start.

schema.label: Sound adjustment
schema.description: normalize evens out loud and quiet parts. voice makes speech a little clearer and evens out the volume. Only affects the audiobook player.

schema.label: Pick up where I stopped on my phone
schema.description: Reads the position you last reached in the Audible app or on another device, and offers it here as a 'Resume from phone' choice. Only reads from Audible. It never jumps to the phone position by itself.

schema.label: Save my position to Audible
schema.description: Sends where you are in a book to Audible, so the Audible app and your other devices can pick it up. Only the book's ID and the position (in milliseconds) are sent. Nothing else. Off by default. Writing positions is not confirmed to work yet, so nothing is sent until that is checked.

schema.label: Dry run (log instead of sending)
schema.description: While on, the plugin only writes the position it would have sent to its log, and sends nothing to Audible. Turn it off only after you have checked the log.
